title: Behavioral Baseline Profiling for Single-GPU Agent Task Detection

original_idea.body:
# Behavioral Baseline Profiling for Single-GPU Agent Task Detection

**Problem:** Detecting rogue agent behavior requires establishing normal behavioral baselines, but no lightweight methodology exists for profiling agent API call sequences on constrained compute (single GPU / Colab).

**Direction:** Run standardized agentic tasks (file I/O, web browsing, code execution) on an open-source agent framework, collect API call sequence logs, and build simple statistical baseline profiles. Test whether injected anomalous behaviors (e.g., unusual file access) exceed detection thresholds.

**Why it matters:** Detection of compromised agents requires establishing 'what normal looks like' — this study provides a replicable methodology for resource-constrained researchers.

**Relevant context:** Inter-agent collusion detection research; Exabeam Agent Behavior Analytics work on behavioral baselines.
